concepts.name: Ivory
concepts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Parcela mascot icon color/material variation. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, Fence Buddy. Preserve the exact three-picket silhouette with the taller center picket, squat wide proportions, rounded pentagonal fence tips, tiny two feet, eye size, eye spacing and eye location. Keep it the same recognizable mascot, not a new creature. Change only its color treatment and remove the contrasting rounded white rectangle behind the eyes entirely. The eyes must sit directly on the continuous fence body. Retain the two simple vertical board seams above the eye line; do not add facial seams or decorative lines. Render as a clean flat vector-like graphic, solid uniform color fields only. Remove the original's subtle shading, mottled texture and gradients. Single centered icon at same scale and position, square transparent canvas, generous margin. Genuinely transparent background. No white face patch, no visor, no screen, no belly patch, no robot face panel, no badges, no wordmark, no letters, no props, no scene, no ground, no shadow, no 3D, no glow, no gradients, no texture. Color treatment: the ENTIRE connected fence body is one uniform warm off-white #EEEDEA, including the area previously occupied by the visor. Two solid charcoal #242424 oval eyes directly on the off-white body. Medium weight charcoal #242424 external contour and two short charcoal board seams, consistent crisp line weight. Only off-white and charcoal. This evokes a white picket fence and should be particularly strong against the site's dark background.
